bagPolicy.summary: Permitted bags include clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags no larger than 13 by 17 inches, one-gallon clear zip bags, small hand-sized clutches, qualifying hydration packs, and waist packs. Medical exceptions are inspected individually.
allowed: Clear bag no larger than 13 by 17 inches
bagPolicy.note: Security makes the final decision at the gate. Review the current official policy immediately before the festival.

parking.note: There is no parking at the Bayfront Park festival site. Ultra recommends Brightline, Tri-Rail, Metrorail, or Metromover; downtown garages and rideshare services are available away from the entrance.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Ultra Music Festival's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Ultra hosts a rotating lineup of local and festival food vendors, including vegan options. Outside food and beverages are prohibited; current offerings are listed on the official food page.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Ultra Music Festival, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Ultra Music Festival's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Ultra Music Festival. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Ultra Music Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
